P.name: Soul Siphon
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Morgana''' {{tip|heal|heals}} herself for 18% of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt by her {{tip|abilities}} against {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|minions}}, and medium and large {{tip|monsters}}.

Q.name: Dark Binding
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Morgana''' throws a sphere of dark magic in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|root|roots}} them for a duration.

W.name: Tormented Shadow
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} ''Tormented Shadow's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 5% of its '''total''' cooldown whenever ''{{ai|Soul Siphon|Morgana}}'' triggers. Simultaneous triggers from multiple targets will stack the cooldown reduction.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Morgana''' torments the soil at the target location, causing the area to become desecrated for 5 seconds. Enemies within take {{as|magic damage}} on-cast and every {{fd|0.5}} seconds thereafter, increased by {{as|{{pp|type=target's '''missing''' health|key=%|key1=%|0 to 100 for 11|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health}}|health}}. ''Tormented Shadow'' deals 170% damage against {{tip|monsters}}.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Minimum Damage Per Tick|{{ap|9 to 35}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|Maximum Damage Per Tick|{{ap|9*2 to 35*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*2}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Minimum Total Damage|{{ap|9*10 to 35*10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*10}}% AP)}}|Maximum Total Damage|{{ap|9*10*2 to 35*10*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*10*2}}% AP)}}}}

E.name: Black Shield
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Morgana''' grants a {{tip|shield}} to the target allied {{tip|champion}} or herself for 5 seconds, which absorbs incoming {{as|magic damage}} and grants {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} while it holds.

R.name: Soul Shackles
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Morgana''' latches chains of energy onto nearby enemy champions over the cast time, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and forming a {{tip|tether}} between herself and each target for 3 seconds, during which she gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and the targets are {{tip|true sight|revealed}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 20%.
R.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|200 to 350}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|200*2 to 350*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|80*2}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|20 to 60}}%}}
R.description2: If a target does not break their tether by the end of its duration, they are dealt the same {{as|magic damage}} again and become {{tip|stun|stunned}} for a duration, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
R.description3: ''An enemy champion within {{tip|cr|icononly=true}} 575 units is required to cast this ability. The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be tethered by this ability.''
